metadata.title: Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome-based streams of B2B document exchange: subscribe, connect partners, order, ship, invoice, replenish, monitor and integrate.
metadata.flowModelNote: Each step names the bricks it depends on; personas are linked through customers.json JTBD steps.

rootGroups.name: Trading Relationship Lifecycle
rootGroups.description: Getting onto the network and connecting each trading partner.

streams.name: Subscribe and Get Ready to Trade Digitally
streams.description: From a retailer's EDI requirement or an e-invoicing deadline to a customer with a plan, users, an ERP link or portal access and security assurance in place.
outcomes: Faster time from first contact to first live message

flows.title: Choose a plan and set up the account
flows.description: A supplier compares plans, buys or requests a quote, sets up users and either integrates its ERP or starts in the portal.

steps.title: Choose a plan
keyFacts: Basic from EUR 79, Plus from EUR 149 per month (annual), Premium on request
Unlimited messages and trading partners
painPoints: Unclear which plan covers SSCC labels or API
